title: Computational Phenomenology of Borderline Personality Disorder: A Comparative Evaluation of LLM-Simulated Expert Personas and Human Clinical Experts

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a specific human researcher's persona (including their professional background and interpretative biases) in LLMs to conduct qualitative thematic analysis of clinical interviews, and comparing the AI outputs against human expert analyses using semantic overlap (Jaccard coefficients), blinded expert validity ratings, and computational text embeddings to identify human omissions and latent AI biases.
